in_marathi.name: Parashar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parashar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parashar is a Sanskrit name derived from Parashara Rishi, who is considered the author of the Mahabharata and the greatest teacher of Vedic scriptures. Parashara means 'supreme teacher' or 'supreme sage'.

Parashara means 'supreme teacher' or 'supreme sage'.
